name: Alistair McGregor
bio:
Alistair McGregor's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the University of Edinburgh, a weekend volunteering stint at a local rally team ignited a lifelong passion. He quickly transitioned from assembling gearboxes to strategizing race tactics, demonstrating a knack for both technical understanding and team leadership. His no-nonsense approach, honed over years of navigating the cutthroat world of racing, has earned him a reputation for demanding excellence. 

 McGregor's distinctive leadership style blends meticulous planning with a willingness to embrace innovation. He believes that success in motorsport hinges on a relentless pursuit of marginal gains, achieved through a combination of cutting-edge technology and unwavering commitment. He is known for his ability to inspire his team to push boundaries and challenge conventional thinking. At Cool Racing, Alistair is building a new era of success.

physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build, with a sharp, focused gaze that reflects his intense personality.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of Colin Chapman's biography.
Insists on personally inspecting every tire before a race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
